title: Which statements about magnets are true?
purpose: Test each statement from a school question: do unlike poles attract, and can every metal be made into a magnet? Then see why a magnet that is dropped many times can lose its magnetism.
fixes: Believing every metal can be made into a magnet, mixing up which poles attract, and not knowing a magnet can lose its magnetism (not in the syllabus LO list, but tested in school papers).
